# Harvested multi-version intermediary-to-Mojang methods and fields

# intermediary IDs were dropped from newer tiny files (a 1.20.1 mod uses
# method IDs that no longer appear in 1.21.11's intermediary). Composed by
# joining Fabric intermediary tiny v2 (CC0-1.0) with Mojang official
# mappings on obfuscated names within each class, descriptor-matched for
# methods (same technique as srg-to-mojang.tsv). Sources: MC 1.16.5, 1.20.1,

# add; resolved via FabricMC intermediary 1.21.11 + Mojang 1.21.11 mappings). #114: Apollo's
# Enchantment Rebalance references TooltipDisplay/Weapon (1.21.5+ item components).
